NBA.MIN: Minutes played per game — the core opportunity stat behind every counting projection.
NBA.TS_PCT: True shooting % — points per shooting possession, counting 2s, 3s, and free throws.
NBA.EFG_PCT: Effective field-goal % — field-goal % that credits a made 3 as 1.5 makes.
NBA.FG3_RATIO: Share of a player's field-goal attempts that are 3-pointers.
NBA.FTR: Free-throw rate — free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt; a proxy for rim pressure.
NBA.USG_PCT: Usage % — share of team possessions a player finishes while on the floor.
NBA.OREB_48: Offensive rebounds per 48 minutes — pace-neutral crash rate.
NBA.PCT_OREB: Share of available offensive rebounds the player grabbed.
NBA.PCT_STL: Share of opponent possessions the player ended with a steal.
NBA.PCT_BLKA: How often the player's own shot was blocked — a finishing-difficulty signal.
NBA.PCT_FG3A: Share of the team's 3-point attempts taken by this player.
NBA.FGA: Field-goal attempts per game — raw shot volume.

WNBA.MIN: Minutes played per game — the core opportunity stat behind every counting projection.
WNBA.TS_PCT: True shooting % — points per shooting possession, counting 2s, 3s, and free throws.
WNBA.E_OFF_RATING: Estimated offensive rating — points produced per 100 possessions.
WNBA.DREB_PCT: Share of available defensive rebounds the player grabbed.
WNBA.OREB_40: Offensive rebounds per 40 minutes — pace-neutral crash rate.
WNBA.PCT_STL: Share of opponent possessions the player ended with a steal.
WNBA.PCT_FG3A: Share of the team's 3-point attempts taken by this player.

NFL.attempts: Pass attempts per game — a quarterback's primary volume stat.
NFL.carries: Rushing attempts per game — a running back's primary volume stat.
NFL.targets: Pass targets per game — a receiver's primary volume stat.
NFL.snap pct: Share of the team's offensive snaps the player was on the field for.
NFL.completion percentage over expected: Completion % above what the throw difficulty predicted.
NFL.passer rating: Passer rating — the composite efficiency score from completions, yards, TDs, and INTs.
NFL.time to throw: Average seconds from snap to release.
NFL.target share: Share of the team's targets that went to this player.
NFL.air yards share: Share of the team's downfield throw distance aimed at this player.
NFL.wopr: Weighted Opportunity Rating — a blend of target share and air-yards share.
NFL.route participation: Share of pass plays on which the player ran a route.
NFL.targets per route run: Targets earned per route run — separation and trust, not just volume.
NFL.redzone target share: Share of the team's red-zone targets — a touchdown-equity signal.
NFL.redzone carry share: Share of the team's red-zone carries — a touchdown-equity signal.
NFL.carry share: Share of the team's carries that went to this player.
NFL.longest completion: Longest single completion in the game.
NFL.longest rush: Longest single rush in the game.
NFL.breakaway yards: Rushing yards gained on runs of 15+ yards.
NFL.midfield target rate: Share of targets between the numbers, away from the sideline.

MLB.plateAppearances: Plate appearances per game — a hitter's core opportunity stat.
MLB.OBP: On-base % — share of plate appearances reaching base.
MLB.ERA: Earned run average — earned runs allowed per nine innings.
MLB.FIP: Fielding-independent pitching — ERA-scaled score from strikeouts, walks, and homers only.
MLB.WHIP: Walks plus hits per inning pitched.
MLB.PA9: Plate appearances faced per nine innings — a workload proxy.

NHL.TimeShare: Share of the game's ice time the player was on for — the core opportunity stat.
NHL.Fenwick: Unblocked shot-attempt differential while on the ice — a possession proxy.
